verdict.rationale: The evidence hints at a programmatic surface: an MCP reference page describes searching the catalog, inspecting server capabilities and keeping your own directory synchronized, and a community user mentions making 'API attempts' to trigger resyncs. Nothing shows that UI actions (hosting configuration, per-tool access control, public/private listing, chat features) are reachable through an API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any common path. missing for 10: a documented public API reference, evidence of API parity with UI actions (deploy, configure, access control, listing visibility, chat), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that the API works end-to-end.
